speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help me understand your condition, please tell me your exact age in hours or days and when these symptoms first started. Did you have a difficult birth, such as a prolonged delivery or need for assistance?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Given the history of prematurity (33 weeks) and onset of respiratory distress within the first few hours of life, the clinical picture is highly suggestive of surfactant deficiency. I will now request an X-ray to confirm the typical "ground glass" appearance and air bronchograms. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.
